title: DeepSeek V4 Official Version Tentatively Scheduled for August 3rd: Silicon Flow Price Hike Exposed, API Can Now Answer New Questions
excerpt: DeepSeek V4's official version was delayed after its gradual testing started in mid-July, and the official has not yet announced the exact release date. However
content_html:
DeepSeek V4's official version was delayed after its gradual testing started in mid-July, and the official has not yet announced the exact release date. However, multiple new clues point to August 3rd being a key node - the Silicon Valley Flow platform first exposed the secret.

The platform announced that it will raise the cache hit price of DeepSeek V4 Pro model from the current 0.1 yuan per million Tokens to 1.0 yuan starting on August 3rd. Such an abrupt price increase can only be reasonably explained by the imminent release of the official version of DeepSeek V4; otherwise, it is hard to explain the motivation behind the Silicon Valley Flow's actions.

APIs become 'smarter' ahead of time, frequent service fluctuations confirm the gradual testing

Another key signal comes from the developer community's test verification. Several netizens found that some DeepSeek V4-related APIs can now correctly answer the release dates of models such as Claude Opus 4.5 and Sonnet 4.5, which were previously unable to be answered without internet access. The tests were conducted through APIs rather than web chats, and not all users could reproduce them, which is a typical feature of gradual testing with phased releases.

Recently, DeepSeek services have frequently experienced instability, which also indirectly confirms that the team is continuously conducting small-scale tests and rolling back changes to refine stability. Since mid-July, DeepSeek has been continuously iterating, and the external expectation is that the official version's performance should at least reach the level between GLM 5.2 and Claude Opus 4.8.

Competitors are not idle: OpenAI cuts prices by 80%, GLM increases prices

The pressure on DeepSeek V4 is not limited to the technical side. OpenAI announced today that the GPT-5.6 series has been reduced by up to 80%, and the cost-effectiveness after the price cut is almost comparable to DeepSeek V4 Pro, combined with multi-modal advantages, the title of the most cost-effective model has already been taken by OpenAI. In contrast, the latest subscription price of GLM has increased by 2 to 3 times in China, making the cost-effectiveness advantage of GPT even more prominent. Under this differentiated situation where competitors are cutting prices to capture the market and raising prices to increase revenue, whether DeepSeek V4 can regain ground with performance may be answered on August 3rd.

content_html_zh:
DeepSeek V4的正式版在7月中旬开始逐步测试后就被推迟了，目前官方尚未公布具体的发布日期。 然而，多个新线索指向8月3日是一个关键节点——硅谷Flow平台率先揭秘。

平台宣布，自8月3日起，将DeepSeek V4 Pro型号的缓存命中价格从目前的0.1元/百万Token上调至1.0元。 如此突然的涨价只能用DeepSeek V4正式版即将发布来合理解释；否则，很难解释“硅谷流”行为背后的动机。

API提前变得“聪明”，频繁的服务波动证实了逐步测试

另一个关键信号来自开发者社区的测试验证。 有网友发现，一些DeepSeek V4相关的API现在可以正确回答Claude Opus 4.5和Sonnet 4.5等模型的发布日期，而此前这些模型在没有网络的情况下无法回答。 测试是通过API而不是网络聊天进行的，并非所有用户都可以重现它们，这是分阶段发布的渐进测试的典型特征。

近期，DeepSeek服务频繁出现不稳定的情况，这也间接印证了团队正在不断进行小规模测试、回滚变更以完善稳定性。 自7月中旬以来，DeepSeek一直在不断迭代，外界的预期是正式版的性能至少应该达到GLM 5.2和Claude Opus 4.8之间的水平。

竞争对手也没闲着：OpenAI降价80%、GLM加价

DeepSeek V4面临的压力不仅限于技术方面。 OpenAI今日宣布GPT-5.6系列降价高达80%，降价后的性价比几乎与DeepSeek V4 Pro相当，结合多模态优势，最具性价比机型的称号已经被OpenAI拿下。 相比之下，GLM最新认购价格在国内上涨了2至3倍，使得GPT的性价比优势更加凸显。 在竞争对手降价抢占市场、涨价增收的差异化形势下，DeepSeek V4能否凭借性能收复失地，或许要到8月3日才能得到答案。
